sources.title: GitHub - eulogik/pico-type: Tiny (1.5M params) byte-level multi-head ...
sources.snippet: pico-type 🔍 A tiny byte-level multi-head content classifier — ~1.5M params, ~209KB ONNX, <6ms inference. Classifies any content into 7 categories from raw bytes in a single forward pass. Built by eulogik — AI infrastructure for developers.

sources.title: Eulogik — AI Infrastructure & Edge Intelligence
sources.snippet: We design, train, and deploy bespoke AI models and enterprise systems — from our open-source edge models (pico-type, NanoForecast) to custom RAG terminals (LexRAG) and private on-premises infrastructure.

sources.title: Pico-Type — Tiny Byte-Level Content Classifier
sources.snippet: Pico‑Type — Bytes In, Answers Out A 1.5-million-parameter, byte-level, multi-head classifier that identifies code language, content type, modality, text language, and risk from raw bytes — no parsing, no dependencies.
